craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of glory in gear — hand-and-emblem song. Lower-shown borne-high; six-spoked kept counted. Rejected: (a) six→many → killed: six is the spokes. Read aloud: WILL-led POW-ers-SHOWN … BORNE, SIX-spoked — YOU.

lines: Will-led powers shown in lower seats three —
own supreme power, thunder-made — borne, six-spoked — You.

reads_against.argmap: What thunderbolt is borne? → Lower-threefold shown, thunderbolt borne six-spoked.
c1_essence: Taken rest in mass; pretext commands.
